coverage_claim: Bounded source-resolution and version-comparison pass for one paper, lane genomics, cutoff 2026-11-16. It covers every openly served artifact of the Nature Biotechnology version and compares the published ablation table with the stored preprint values. It is not a retrieval of the peer-reviewed body, not a literature search, and no value was reproduced by running a model.
decision: Source-resolution and comparison pass for the published GPN-MSA paper (issue #226). The peer-reviewed body could not be retrieved, but the published ablation table, supplement, figure captions and front and back matter could. All 136 stored values from the preprint's Supplementary Table 4 were compared with the same cells of the published Extended Data Table 1; none differs, so no correction claim was written. The batch holds 5 sources and 8 claims and no result, because duplicating 136 identical values under a second source would create false agreement in the graph. Also checked for the stale preview-PDF pin the GPN-Star extractor found in the same 2026-10-14 pass: it does not occur here. The store holds no Springer artifact for GPN-MSA, the published side is the version of record with no accelerated preview stage, and the stored bioRxiv hash is unreproducible by design rather than stale.
excluded: Published Supplementary Tables 1 and 2 (16 held-out accuracy and perplexity cells): present in both versions with identical values, left out of the store by the earlier batch's scope call; recorded as a claim, not as results.

Published Supplementary Table 5 (best score quantiles for gene-level scores): new in the published version, but a selection setting rather than a measured result, and the store holds no gene-essentiality protocol to attach it to.

Published Supplementary Tables 3, 4 and 6 and the Reporting Summary: lists, hyperparameters and a reporting form, no measured values. The Reporting Summary names Ensembl VEP Release 109 and Hugging Face Transformers 4.29.2, recorded in scope-audit.jsonl as a lead.
failed_candidates: The peer-reviewed Results and Methods text: paywalled at nature.com and absent from PMC, Europe PMC, Unpaywall and OpenAlex. The two stored DMS TADBP AUROCs (GPN-MSA 0.83, ESM-1b 0.75) are quoted in that text and could not be compared.
eScholarship: HTTP 403 to curl; not pursued further because the OA indexes list no repository copy.
gaps: Published Results and Methods body not retrieved; 2 of the 138 stored preprint values could not be compared.
Extended Data Table 1 is published only as a raster image with no text layer, so npm run batch -- check-values cannot verify the published values and the comparison rests on a visual transcription.
Extended Data Figures 1 to 8, Figure 1 and Figure 2 print no numbers beyond sample sizes, and no Source Data file is published.
No OCR tool was available in the environment, so there is no second machine reading of the table image.

The stored preprint source's pinned SHA-256 cannot be reproduced by re-download, because bioRxiv stamps each copy. The record declares this in hash_scope; the reproducible check is the text layer, which passes. No copy of the pinned bytes is archived in the repository.
